title: The Wisdom of Our Mothers (የእናቶቻችን ጥበብ)
logline: A tribute to the women who may never have had the chance to attend school themselves, yet made education their greatest dream for their children.

style_block.lighting: Warm morning golden hour, diffused window sunlight, glowing kerosene lamp ember warmth, misty mountain dawn
style_block.color_palette: Earthy ochre, terraced emerald greens, warm unbleached cotton whites, touches of deep crimson and gold embroidery
style_block.cinematography: Arri Alexa look, shallow depth of field, center-safe subject framing, organic handheld and slow push-in movement
style_block.cultural_anchors: Authentic Ethiopian Netela woven white cotton scarf with delicate Tibeb embroidery, black clay Jebena coffee pot, earthen kitchen, Kuraz kerosene lamp, highland landscape

mother_character.name: Almaz
